title: Manager - Regional Product development
description:
**Job Details** 




 To introduce the right regional products by generating an in\-depth understanding of cultural, ritualistic and community specific requirements for jewelry and by undertaking extensive indexing of relevant competition. On this basis to work closely with the Cluster management and the regional teams for determining the appropriate sales plan and the supporting assortment plans. This role will also be responsible for identifying regionally relevant products or categories that can be imbued with Tanishq’s signature and promoted as such. As a part of the WiMI programme, this role will also work closely with the regional DEC and the Cluster management teams on the development of regionally relevant, marketed collections aligned to regional marketing calendar
 



  





**Merchandising: Planning for Regional Products** 




 1\. Mapping the current universe of regional products
 



 2\. Range\-planning for regional products: Identifying the gaps in the current universe, based on customer, community understanding as well as competitive indexing. Accordingly, planning for product introduction for ensuring that these product gaps are filled
 



 3\. Collaborating with the regional vendors to ensure the development of products to fill the product gap happens on a regular \& timely basis.
 



 4\. Wherever required, work closely with the Responsible Sourcing teams for the timely onboarding on relevant and capable vendor partners
 



 5\. Review of product performance and decision making on product continuation 6\. Engaging closely with the Retail stores for driving decisions on range expansion/discontinuation
 



  





**Developing a Robust vendor ecosystem for regional products** 




 1\. Evaluating the current vendor ecosystem for regional products both in terms of expertise \& cost 2\. Periodic visits to the vendors to understand their capability as well to get inputs from vendors on regional products.
 



 3\. Conduct existing vendor performance evaluations based on product performance and evaluate new vendors based on the skill set planning.
 



 4\. On boarding the right new vendors in terms of expertise \& cost as per the gap observed in the current regional vendor eco\-system
 



  





**Periodic Competition Indexing** 




 1\. Monthly visits to regional competition to benchmark the regional products offered, weight bands, making charge ...etc.
 



 2\. Synthesis of actionable insights and incorporation into the Range plan
 



  





**Product Management: Product Portfolio Management** 




 1\. Manage the entire product lifecycle from inception to product retiral for regional products.
 



 2\. Achieve Category Top Line Targets as per planned Cat\-PB sales shares of regional products.
 



 3\. Provide inputs on the model stock recommendations for assortment planning.
 



 4\. Ensure the effective cascade of the newly launched regional products with all the internal teams including Retail, VM, Marketing etc.
 



 5\. Identify poor performing products and propose measures for ensuring their liquidation.
 



 6\. Identify the best possible offers based on the seasonality in the region \& the profitability of the product.
 



  





**Merchandising: Launch Region specific Collections** 




 1\. Create the new collection brief for the regional collection with clear deliverables on the product category, cluster, net weight \& LC
 



 2\. Liaison with the NPD team, Design team to ensure the concept presentation as per the timeline. 3\. Approve/ select the designs created by the design studio.
 



 4\. Approve the final PDIS release; Coordinate with NPI team for code creation.
 



 5\. Coordinate with the NPD \& NPIM team to ensure that the first set of proto are received as per the design approved – if not ensuring that the feedback is given for correction.
 



 6\. Support the NPD to conduct regional NPIM for the collection.
 



 7\. Conduct periodic canvassing with L3s for indent enhancement, seasonal up stocking etc. to improve new product penetration.
 



 8\. Collaborate with marketing for ad\-variant planning
 



  





**Job Requirements** 




 Education \- Graduate Relevant Experience 10 \-15 years with experience in Sourcing or Product development or Design or Merchandising functions with National or Regional jewelry brands.
 



 Prior work in the jewelry sector and a thorough understanding of regional nuances is a must Behavioural Skills
 



 • High level of Customer orientation
 



 • Drive for results
 



 • Networking ability
 



 • Detail orientation Knowledge
 



 • Category management experience
 



 • Business acumen
 



 • Analytical ability
 



 • Vendor management experience

title: GTM Architect
description:
**ABOUT JMAN:** 




 JMAN Group is a fast\-growing data engineering \& data science consultancy. We work primarily with Private Equity Funds and their Portfolio Companies to create commercial value using Data \& Artificial Intelligence. In addition, we also work with growth businesses, large corporates, multinationals, and charities.
 



  





 We are headquartered in London with Offices in New York, London and Chennai. Our team of over 450 people is a unique blend of individuals with skills across commercial consulting, data science and software engineering.
 



  





 We were founded by cousins Anush Newman (Co\-founder \& CEO) and Leo Valan (Co\-founder \& CTO) and have grown rapidly since 2019\. In May 2023 we took a minority investment from Baird Capital and in January 2024 we opened an office in New York with the ambition of growing our US business to be as large as, if not bigger than, our European business by 2027\.
 



  





**Why work at JMAN:** 




 Our vision is to ensure JMAN Group is the passport to our team’s future. We want our team to go on a fast\-paced, high\-growth journey with us – when our people want to do something else, the skills, training, exposure, and values that JMAN has instilled in them should open doors all over the world.
 



 Current Benefits:
 



 − Competitive annual bonus
 



 − Market\-leading private health insurance
 



 − Regular company socials
 



 − Annual company away days
 



 − Extensive training opportunities
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 The GTM Architect will be the strategic bridge between JMAN product and delivery capabilities and our global client client partners (US/UK), driving sales enablement, value creation, and delivery alignment for the Private Equity and portfolio client ecosystem.
 



  





 While the primary focus is on sales enablement and value creation, this role will also oversee delivery management for active accounts to ensure solution promises translate into client outcomes.
 



  





 This position is ideal for senior professionals with technology presales experience with a MBA from a reputed Indian B\-School who can combine commercial acumen, solution storytelling, and operational discipline to scale our go\-to\-market efforts.
 



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 



* 5–10 years in technology presales, GTM, or solution consulting roles in tech services, consulting, or SaaS/product firms.
* MBA from a reputed Indian B\-School (like, IIM, ISB, XLRI, SPJIMR, Great Lakes etc.) with strong exposure to GTM, consulting, or tech solutioning.
* Good understanding of Private Equity ecosystem and portfolio value creation levers (preferred).
* Proven ability to design value propositions linking solutions to business outcomes.
* Excellent communication and storytelling skills. Ability to articulate impactful solution presentations.
* Experience in managing or overseeing delivery teams to ensure alignment with GTM objectives.
* Exposure to data, analytics, cloud, or AI\-led solutions is a plus.



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Sales Enablement \& Solution Readiness
 *(Core Focus)***



* Develop solution playbooks, value propositions, and proposal templates tailored for PE and portfolio clients.
* Partner with US/UK Client Partners to craft impactful client pitches, proposal response and data \& AI solution narratives.
* Lead solutioning workshops with Delivery, Labs, and CoEs for cross\-functional GTM alignment.
* Maintain a centralized repository of sales assets, proof points, and case studies.



**Value Creation Strategy
 *(Core Focus)***



* Map JMAN’s data \& AI solution offerings to portfolio business value drivers (e.g. top\-line growth, margin improvement, operational efficiency, etc).
* Quantify and articulate ROI outcomes for client proposals.
* Contribute to strategic account plans and market expansion strategies.



**Delivery Management
 *(Supporting Focus)***



* Work with Tech Delivery Leads and PMO to monitor project progress for strategic accounts.
* Ensure delivery outputs align with agreed solution value propositions, and business outcomes.
* Identify opportunities to expand accounts through insights from delivery engagements.



**Global GTM Collaboration \& Governance** 



* Serve as the India\-based GTM anchor for global pursuits, ensuring quick turnaround and time zone coverage.
* Align with Marketing to drive campaigns and thought leadership tied to target accounts.
* Support PMO with pipeline tracking, conversion analytics, and win\-loss reviews.
* Run bi\-weekly GTM huddles with US/UK partners to review opportunity pipeline.

title: Shopify CRO Manager
description:
We are seeking a highly analytical and commercially minded Shopify CRO Manager to own our end\-to\-end conversion rate optimisation programme.
 



 The role is responsible for the complete process from insight and hypothesis through experiment design, tracking QA, launch, statistical evaluation, winner rollout and measurable CVR/revenue impact.
 



 This position is not limited to marketplace listing optimisation, paid advertising or campaign execution. The successful candidate will improve the Shopify customer journey by working closely with dedicated Data Analyst, UI/UX, development, content and merchandising teams.
 


 Key responsibilities
 * Own the Shopify CRO roadmap across product pages, category/collection pages, search, navigation, cart and checkout.
* Analyse customer behaviour, funnel performance, device performance, engagement data and commercial results to identify conversion opportunities.
* Create structured hypotheses supported by evidence and prioritise experiments based on expected impact, confidence and effort.
* Define primary KPIs, secondary metrics, guardrail metrics, target audience, test duration and success criteria before each experiment.
* Partner with the Data Analyst to ensure accurate event tracking, dashboards, data quality and reliable post\-test analysis.
* Brief UI/UX, content and development teams with clear experiment requirements and expected customer/business outcomes.
* Conduct pre\-launch QA including tracking validation, mobile/desktop review, browser testing, localisation, merchandising checks and rollback readiness.
* Launch and monitor A/B tests and other controlled experiments without disrupting customer experience or trading performance.
* Evaluate test outcomes using appropriate statistical methods; distinguish meaningful uplift from inconclusive or false\-positive results.
* Roll out confirmed winners, document learning, and ensure results are incorporated into future product and page templates.
* Maintain an experiment backlog, prioritisation framework, testing calendar, QA checklist and executive reporting.
* Present clear recommendations and revenue/CVR impact to senior stakeholders.


 Required qualifications and experience
 * 4\+ years of experience in conversion rate optimisation, e\-commerce growth, digital analytics, product experimentation or a related role.
* Proven experience personally owning website experiments from hypothesis to successful rollout.
* Hands\-on experience with Shopify and a strong understanding of D2C e\-commerce journeys.
* Strong knowledge of A/B testing, control/variant design, sample size, statistical significance, confidence levels and incremental impact.
* Experience using GA4, Google Tag Manager, Shopify Analytics and reporting tools such as Looker Studio, Power BI or Tableau.
* Ability to work effectively with Data, UI/UX, developers, content, merchandising and commercial stakeholders.
* Strong analytical thinking, structured communication and project\-management skills.
* Ability to prioritise high\-impact initiatives in a fast\-moving e\-commerce environment.


 Preferred qualifications
 * Experience with experimentation platforms such as VWO, Optimizely, Convert, AB Tasty or similar.
* SQL knowledge and experience working with product, customer or web\-behaviour datasets.
* Experience with heatmaps/session\-replay tools such as Hotjar, Contentsquare, Microsoft Clarity or similar.
* Experience improving international e\-commerce stores, localised content or multi\-market Shopify storefronts.
* Experience in fitness, consumer goods, retail or high\-consideration D2C products.


 How success will be measured
 * Conversion\-rate uplift across key Shopify journeys.
* Incremental revenue and profitability generated through experiments.
* Quality and speed of the hypothesis\-to\-launch process.
* Accuracy of tracking, QA and statistical evaluation.
* Number and impact of winning experiments successfully rolled out.
* Clear documentation and adoption of learnings across teams.


 Application requirement
 
 Candidates should share 2\-3 examples of experiments they personally owned, including:
 


* The hypothesis and business problem
* Primary KPI and test setup
* Test duration/sample size approach
* Result and statistical conclusion
* Final rollout decision and measurable business impact

**Marketing Operations Strategy and Operating Model** 



* Build and own the Marketing Operations roadmap, operating model and quarterly priorities.
* Create a clear intake and prioritisation process so the function focuses on work with measurable pipeline or efficiency impact.
* Establish documentation, change\-management and continuity standards for critical systems and workflows.
* Partner with Marketing, RevOps, SDR leadership and Finance on shared definitions, processes and service\-level agreements.



**Marketing Systems and Lifecycle** 



* Own and continuously improve HubSpot's marketing architecture, including properties, workflows, segmentation, campaign structures, lifecycle automation and integrations.
* Define and maintain lifecycle stages, qualification criteria, lead and account scoring, nurture paths, routing and SDR handoffs in partnership with RevOps.
* Improve data quality through reliable enrichment, deduplication, field standards, governance and exception monitoring across contact and company records.
* Create documentation, change\-control practices and service\-level agreements that make critical processes reliable and easy to operate.
* Monitor routing performance and SLA adherence, using SDR feedback to improve lead and account quality over time.



**GTM Intelligence and Market Research** 



* Build and maintain the target\-account universe for IT and mid\-market segments, with clear ICP tiers, verticals, regions, use cases and buying groups.
* Run the Marketing Research Engine (MRE) as a repeatable intelligence process that produces campaign\-ready and SDR\-ready audiences not one\-off lists.
* Combine fit, engagement, intent and timing sign signals to prioritise accounts and recommend the appropriate nurture, campaign or SDR action.
* Use campaign outcomes and SDR feedback to improve data sources, segments, scoring models and targeting decisions over time.
* Evaluate enrichment and intelligence tools based on coverage, accuracy, cost and measurable impact on pipeline generation.



**Measurement, Attribution and Planning** 



* Own Marketing's metrics layer and data dictionary, including lifecycle definitions, sourcing, influence and pipeline contribution.
* Build practical attribution and reporting across inbound, outbound, paid, events, partners and account\-based programs.
* Translate funnel, campaign, channel and account performance into recommendations on audience, investment and next\-best action.
* Partner with Growth, RevOps and Finance on trusted dashboards, budget\-versus\-actual reporting, forecasting and data\-quality controls.



**Campaign Operations and Enablement** 



* Turn audience and campaign strategy into scalable, measurable programs with Growth, Segment Marketing and Demand Generation.
* Standardise campaign setup, taxonomy, UTMs, lists, forms, nurture, routing, QA and post\-campaign reporting.
* Build reusable playbooks for webinars, events, content, paid, partner and targeted\-account programs.
* Support Web and Growth teams with form architecture, conversion tracking and experiment instrumentation.
* Equip SDR teams with prioritised audiences, campaign context, timely alerts and feedback loops while keeping sales execution with SDR leadership.



**AI\-Enabled Automation** 



* Identify, pilot and scale AI\-enabled workflows for research, enrichment, qualification, routing, campaign QA, reporting and operational insight.
* Build practical automations in HubSpot, n8n and related tools; partner with technical teams when a solution requires custom APIs or data infrastructure.
* Apply appropriate human review, monitoring, fallback paths and documentation so automation remains accurate, safe and maintainable.
* Measure adoption, accuracy, hours saved, workflow reliability and business impact rather than tool usage alone.



**What Success Looks Like in the First Six Months** 



* Publish a prioritised Marketing Operations roadmap with clear ownership, service levels and dependencies.
* Standardise lifecycle stages, qualification, routing and SDR handoffs, with visible exception and SLA reporting.
* Establish an account\-level mid\-market data model with ICP tiers, scoring signals and buying\-group coverage.
* Launch a trusted full\-funnel reporting view that connects campaign and channel investment to pipeline outcomes.
* Put two or more AI\-enabled or automated workflows into regular use with measurable gains in speed, quality or decision\-making.



  





**What You Bring** 




**Must\-Have** 



* 6\+ years of B2B marketing operations, revenue operations or GTM operations experience, ideally in SaaS.
* Deep hands\-on HubSpot expertise across workflows, lifecycle management, segmentation, scoring, reporting and integrations.
* Experience designing lead\-to\-revenue processes in a sales\-led or hybrid motion involving Marketing, SDRs and Account Executives.
* Strong command of funnel metrics, attribution, campaign taxonomy, UTM governance and pipeline reporting.
* Hands\-on automation experience with tools such as n8n, Zapier, Make or Workato, and working knowledge of APIs and webhooks.
* Strong data fluency, including advanced spreadsheets and experience with BI tools, SQL or equivalent analysis methods.
* A track record of turning ambiguous business needs into adopted systems, workflows, metrics and documentation.
* Clear cross\-functional communication and the judgment to align Marketing, Sales, RevOps and Finance stakeholders.



**Strong Advantage**

 We are looking for enthusiastic, self\-motivated, and result\-oriented professionals to join our team as Business Development Executives. * Generate, qualify, and nurture leads for product demonstrations and sales discussions.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
**About the Role** 




 We are looking for an experienced Marketing Lead to own and drive the end\-to\-end marketing strategy for our product. This role will be responsible for developing and executing marketing initiatives that drive brand awareness, demand generation, customer acquisition, adoption, conversion and business growth while leading a team of marketers.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 




  




* Own the overall marketing strategy, roadmap, and execution across user acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, and product adoption.

* Foster a culture of experimentation, innovation, accountability, and continuous learning within the marketing organization.
* Evaluate and leverage modern marketing technologies, AI tools, automation platforms, and analytics solutions to improve team productivity and business outcomes.



  





**Requirements:** 



* 6\+ years of experience leading Growth Marketing, Product Marketing, or Integrated Marketing functions within a SaaS, technology, or internet company.
* Proven track record of driving user growth, engagement, retention, and product adoption for global products.
* Strong experience in product launches, go\-to\-market strategy, feature launches, and lifecycle marketing.
* Deep understanding of growth frameworks, customer acquisition strategies, conversion optimization, and retention marketing.
* Hands\-on expertise with marketing analytics and SEO tools such as Google Analytics, Looker, Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, Botify, and similar platforms.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into actionable business decisions.
* Experience building and scaling content engines across video, social, community, webinars, and creator\-led channels.
* Strong understanding of modern SEO, content marketing, organic growth, and performance marketing best practices.
* Experience managing multi\-channel acquisition programs including organic, paid, influencer, partnership, and referral channels.
* Excellent product storytelling, positioning, messaging, and communication skills.
* Comfortable presenting to customers, partners, leadership teams, and large audiences through webinars, demos, and events.
* Demonstrated success in building, managing, and developing high\-performing marketing teams.
* Strong understanding of branding, customer experience, and market positioning.
* Highly execution\-oriented with the ability to balance strategy and hands\-on delivery.
* Curious, adaptable, and passionate about experimenting with new tools, technologies, and growth opportunities.
* Experience in video technology, creator economy, content platforms, AI products, or PLG businesses will be a strong advantage.

 1\-2\-Taste is transforming the B2B food ingredients industry through a digital, AI\-managed marketplace that optimizes how ingredients are sourced, sold, and innovated. Business customers can easily find and order a broad range of food ingredients from trusted suppliers. The platform is built on transparency in pricing, reliable delivery, and efficient supply chain management. This combination of technology and service quality makes 1\-2\-Taste a distinctive player in the global food ingredients market and an engaging environment for performance\-driven marketing professionals.
 



  





  





**Role Description** 




 Drive qualified lead generation and conversion growth through performance marketing campaigns, while ensuring accurate, reliable and actionable tracking and analytics across all digital channels.
 



  





 The ideal candidate should be equally strong in Performance Marketing and Marketing Analytics, with hands\-on expertise in Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Analytics 4 (GA4\), conversion tracking, event tracking, debugging and data validation.
 



  





**Key Result Areas (KRAs)**



* Increasing qualified leads
* Campaign ROI \- Efficient advertising spend
* Conversion Optimisation \- Improving conversion rates
* Tracking \& Measurement \- Accurate and reliable marketing data
* Analytics \& Reporting \- Clear performance visibility and actionable insights
* Data Quality\- Ensuring consistency between website activity, GTM and GA4



  





**1\. Performance Marketing** 



* Manage and optimise Google Ads, Meta Ads and LinkedIn Ads campaigns.
* Plan and execute campaigns based on lead generation and business objectives.
* Optimise targeting, audiences, budgets, bidding and campaign structures.
* Monitor CPL, conversion rates, ROAS and overall campaign performance.
* Identify opportunities to improve lead quality and reduce acquisition costs.
* Conduct A/B testing of campaigns, audiences, landing pages and creatives.



  





**2\. Google Tag Manager (GTM) – Advanced Expertise** 



* Take complete ownership of Google Tag Manager containers and tracking implementation.
* Create, configure and manage Tags, Triggers and Variables based on business and marketing requirements.
* Implement tracking for key website interactions such as:
* Form submissions
* CTA/button clicks
* Product/category page visits
* Sample requests
* Contact/lead forms
* Downloads
* Outbound clicks
* Scroll depth and engagement events
* Other important user journeys and conversion actions
* Maintain a clear and structured GTM container with proper naming conventions and documentation.
* Manage GTM versions, workspaces and publishing processes.
* Identify and troubleshoot duplicate, missing or incorrectly configured tags.
* Ensure that tracking implementations do not negatively impact website performance.



  





**3\. Google Analytics 4 (GA4\) – Advanced Expertise** 



* Take ownership of GA4 configuration, events, parameters, conversions and reporting.
* Configure and manage GA4 events and relevant event parameters.
* Define and maintain a clear measurement framework for the website and marketing campaigns.
* Configure relevant conversions/key events in GA4\.
* Ensure important user actions and business outcomes are properly captured.
* Analyze user journeys, acquisition sources, engagement and conversion behaviour.
* Create and maintain relevant GA4 explorations, reports and audiences.
* Ensure campaign data such as source, medium, campaign and other relevant parameters are captured correctly.



  





**4\. Tracking Validation, Testing \& Debugging** 




*This is a critical responsibility of the role.*



* Test every major tracking implementation before and after deployment.
* Use GTM Preview/Debug mode, GA4 DebugView and browser developer tools to validate tracking.
* Verify that the correct event is triggered when a user performs the intended action.
* Verify that the correct parameters and values are being passed with each event.
* Cross\-check that the data fired through Google Tag Manager is correctly received and recorded in GA4\.
* Identify discrepancies between:
* Website → GTM → GA4 → Advertising Platforms
* Test whether conversions are being recorded correctly and only once.
* Identify and resolve duplicate events, missing events, incorrect parameters and incorrectly firing tags.
* Perform regression testing whenever changes are made to the website, GTM or GA4 configuration.
* Regularly audit the tracking setup to ensure data accuracy and consistency.
* Maintain a tracking QA checklist and document any issues, fixes and changes made.



  





 5\. Conversion \& Campaign Tracking
 


* Implement and validate conversion tracking for Google Ads, Meta and LinkedIn.
* Ensure UTM parameters and campaign tracking are correctly implemented.
* Verify that campaign source/medium/campaign information is correctly attributed in GA4\.
* Ensure leads generated through different channels can be accurately identified and attributed.
* Troubleshoot discrepancies between advertising\-platform conversions and GA4 conversions.
* Continuously improve the accuracy of attribution and conversion measurement.



 6\. Analytics \& Reporting
 


* Maintain marketing dashboards and performance reports.
* Track key metrics including MQLs, leads, CPL, conversion rate, ROAS and campaign performance.
* Provide insights rather than simply reporting numbers.
* Identify trends, anomalies and tracking issues proactively.
* Highlight actionable recommendations for improving campaign and website performance.
* Ensure reporting data is based on properly validated tracking.



  





**Technical Skills Required**




*Must\-Have*



* Strong hands\-on experience with Google Tag Manager (GTM).
* Strong hands\-on experience with Google Analytics 4 (GA4\).
* Advanced understanding of GTM containers, Tags, Triggers and Variables.
* Strong understanding of GA4 Events and Event Parameters.
* Experience implementing and testing conversion tracking.
* Experience debugging GTM and GA4 tracking issues.
* Ability to validate data flow from website → GTM → GA4 → advertising platforms.
* Strong understanding of UTM parameters and campaign attribution.
* Experience with Google Ads conversion tracking.
* Experience with Meta Pixel and LinkedIn Insight Tag.
* Ability to independently identify and fix tracking discrepancies.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.



*Good to Have*



* Understanding of Google Search Console.
* Basic understanding of JavaScript/dataLayer.
* Experience with CRM and marketing automation integrations.
* Experience with server\-side tracking/conversion APIs.
* Experience working with B2B lead\-generation websites.



  





**Ideal Candidate**




 We are looking for someone who is not just a campaign manager, but a hands\-on performance marketer who understands how data is generated, captured, validated and used to make marketing decisions.
 



  





 The candidate should be comfortable asking:
 



  





 “Did the user action actually fire?” → “Did GTM capture it correctly?” → “Did GA4 receive it correctly?” → “Was the correct parameter passed?” → “Was the conversion recorded correctly?” → “Can we trust the number in the report?”
 



  





 The candidate should be capable of independently setting up, testing, debugging and validating the complete tracking ecosystem without relying solely on developers or external analytics teams.
 


* KPI Owned
* KPI Target / Expectation
* MQL Generation Increasing
* Cost per Lead Optimized
* ROAS High
* Conversion Rate Improving
* Tracking Accuracy High
* Conversion Data Integrity 100% validated
* Reporting Accurate and actionable
